notes: Reference eval set for this skill. Also serves as the fixture used by tests/test_bundle.py.
Every assertion here uses a type implemented by scripts/grade.py.

evals.query: Create a new agent skill called pdf-notes that tells an agent how to write a summary of a PDF into a markdown file. Write it to ./pdf-notes/SKILL.md and validate it.
evals.expected_output: A skill directory containing SKILL.md with kebab-case name `pdf-notes` and a description stating both the goal and when to use it. The skill passes quick_validate.py.

evals.query: My CI job keeps failing on a flaky integration test. Rewrite src/api.js so the retry logic is correct and the test passes.
evals.expected_output: The agent edits the JavaScript file. This skill is about authoring and evaluating agent skills, so it should not be the mechanism used, and it must not interfere with the edit.

assertions.text: Judge did not apply this eval's workflow to a plain code-fix task

evals.query: Make a skill for reviewing database migrations. I want to know whether it actually gets triggered when it should, so build eval cases and run them against my agent CLI.
evals.expected_output: An evals.json with both trigger-positive and trigger-negative cases, a baseline run without the skill, a with-skill run, and an aggregate that reports the delta between them.

assertions.text: Eval set distinguishes trigger-positive from trigger-negative cases

evals.query: Build me a new skill called standup-notes that turns a messy team standup thread into a short summary. It should end up somewhere I can commit.
evals.expected_output: A new standup-notes skill directory: SKILL.md with a kebab-case name matching the directory, a description stating the goal and when to use it, an evals.json containing at least one should_trigger:false case, and a passing quick_validate. The author role in agents/author.md is the intended mechanism.

assertions.text: The new skill ships its own eval set
The new eval set includes a trigger-negative case

evals.query: Write a haiku about autumn leaves and save it to haiku.txt.
evals.expected_output: A three-line poem in haiku.txt. No agent skill is warranted; authoring a skill here would be a misfire.

assertions.text: No skill was authored or scaffolded for this one-off creative task
